candidates.change_summary: Remove the require that msg.value equals 1 ether, allowing lockInGuess without payment.
Change block.number + 1 to block.number, making the settlement block the current block instead of the next one.
Remove the assignment of block, so lockInGuess no longer sets the block after guessing.
Remove the assignment of guess, so lockInGuess stores nothing for the guess hash.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(2 ether)` with `payable(tx.origin).transfer(2 ether)` so ETH is sent to tx.origin instead of msg.sender.
Change the transfer amount from `2 ether` to `1 ether`.
Remove the require that checks block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block, allowing settlement in the same block the guess was locked.
Remove the line `guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;` so the same state can be settled multiple times.
Change the condition from `answer != 0` to `answer == 0` so the transfer only happens when blockhash returns zero.
Change the blockhash source from `guesses[msg.sender].block` to `guesses[msg.sender].block - 1` so the answer is derived from the previous block.
